text: The minimum supported version of asgiref is increased from 3.8.1 to 3.9.1.
Migrations now support serialization of zoneinfo.ZoneInfo instances.
The new variable forloop.length is now available within a for loop.
The undocumented django.utils.itercompat.is_iterable() function and the django.utils.itercompat module are removed.

Setting ADMINS or MANAGERS to a list of (name, address) tuples is deprecated. Set to a list of email address strings instead. Django never used the name portion. To include a name, format the address string as '"Name" <address>' or use Python's email.utils.formataddr.
The querystring template tag now accepts multiple positional arguments, which must be mappings, such as django.http.QueryDict or dict.
ReactDOM.findDOMNode has been removed and applications should replace calls with DOM refs.
React 19 no longer distributes UMD builds; script-based deployments should use an ESM CDN.
The chat.instructionsFilesLocations setting controls where VS Code looks for instruction files.
The Node extension host supports ESM extensions when package.json sets type to module.
Container queries now inspect flat-tree ancestors in shadow DOM and may alter the selected CSS container.
IndexedDB requests now raise NotFoundError when the backing data file is missing from disk.
